releases.title: Updates & Patch Notes
notes: The app now checks for new versions and lets you know when an update is ready.
See what changed in every version: tap the info button on the Alarms tab.
A short "What's New" summary appears the first time you open a new version.

releases.title: Control Center
notes: New Ask Assistant control: type or dictate a request from Control Center and get the reply without opening the app.
New Live Talk control: jump straight into hands-free talking.
Ask the assistant through Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts or the Action button.

releases.title: To-Dos & Widgets
notes: New To-Do tab with suggested deadlines like "Tonight" or "Tomorrow morning", plus custom times.
Get a notification at each deadline, with Mark as Done and Remind Me in 1 Hour buttons.
New To-Do widget for the home and lock screen: check items off without opening the app.
The Next Alarm widget now comes in a home screen size.
The assistant can now create, change and delete alarms and to-dos, and change your settings.

releases.title: Timers & Talk
notes: New Timers tab. Timers ring even in Silent mode and count down on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.
New Talk tab: a private assistant that runs on your iPhone. Chat by text, or talk hands-free with Live Talk.
Optional wake word, so Live Talk only answers when you start with it.
The assistant can start, list and cancel timers.

releases.title: Smarter Dismiss
notes: Dismissing the next ring of a repeating alarm is more reliable and no longer needs you to open the app afterwards.

releases.title: First Release
notes: Alarms for any days of the week that ring like the built-in Clock app, even in Silent mode.
Lock screen widget showing when your next alarm goes off.
A heads-up notification 1 hour before each alarm, with a button to dismiss that ring.
Open the app within the hour to dismiss it from there too.
